summary: Placeholder CHOP that does not alter incoming channels. Use it as a stable CHOP export/reference endpoint so upstream CHOP networks can change without rewiring parameter exports.

key_params.name: cooktype
key_params.note: Controls how downstream nodes are triggered when the Null CHOP output changes: Automatic, Always, or Selective.

key_params.name: checkvalues
key_params.note: In Selective cook mode, recook downstream when channel values change.

key_params.name: checknames
key_params.note: In Selective cook mode, recook downstream when channel names change.

key_params.name: checkrange
key_params.note: In Selective cook mode, recook downstream when the channel sample range changes.

key_params.name: timeslice
key_params.note: Forces output channels to be time sliced on the Common page.

key_params.name: scope
key_params.note: Restricts which channels are affected by Common-page CHOP operations.

key_params.name: srselect
key_params.note: Chooses how to handle mismatched input sample rates.

key_params.name: exportmethod
key_params.note: Chooses how CHOP channels connect to destination parameters for exports.

key_params.name: autoexportroot
key_params.note: Root path for Channel Name is Path:Parameter export destinations.

key_params.name: exporttable
key_params.note: DAT table that stores export information for DAT Table export methods.

key_params.name: commonrenamefrom
key_params.note: Pattern for renaming output channels on the Common page.

key_params.name: commonrenameto
key_params.note: Replacement pattern for Common-page channel renaming.

common_gotchas: Selective cook mode can reduce downstream recooks for mostly static output, but upstream CHOPs still cook when their inputs change.
Pick the Export Method deliberately: DAT Table by Name is safer than index-based exports when channel names are stable and channel order may change.
Use an Info CHOP on export-heavy Null CHOPs; export_sernum tells you how often export connections have been updated.
Name Null CHOPs descriptively, such as null_audio_level, so parameter exports and references stay readable.
